Connect Rasayel to any and all of your tools.

![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/zqDjsVKi0WzoMjglVyiQxeOeaI.png)

## Connect all your sales tools to WhatsApp

Integrate Rasayel with your CRM and other tools to turn every new conversation into an opportunity. Capture leads and ensure that your sales teams act quickly.

Automate reminders and ensure timely follow-ups to help you maintain a healthy pipeline.

For instance:

- **Rasayel to Salesforce/Airtable**-Capture new conversation leads in your CRM, enabling quick sales follow-up and pipeline management.

- **Rasayel to Odoo/Zoho CRM** \- Log customer interactions for comprehensive support history tracking.


## "90% of our deals are closed on WhatsApp thanks to Rasayel"

## Improve Customer Support with Ticket Automation

Connect Rasayel to your support platform. When a new message arrives, a support ticket is automatically generated, ensuring no customer query goes unnoticed.

Examples:

- **Rasayel to Zendesk/Freshdesk** \- Generate support tickets from new messages.


![](https://framerusercontent.com/images/gl7gqyRbXprAxkTmnJRLRH4Q1Uw.png)

## Better E-commerce Customer Relations

Trigger loyalty program actions or send follow-up messages to create a memorable e-commerce experience that encourages repeat business.

Examples:

- **Rasayel to Klaviyo/Omnisend** \- Trigger personalized email campaigns from customer interactions.

- **Rasayel to Shopify/BigCommerce** \- Update customer profiles based on chat interactions for tailored marketing strategies.

## Improve Team Collaboration

Update your team in real-time as conversation statuses change in Rasayel. Ensure that all team members are promptly informed and can collaborate effectively.

Examples

- **Rasayel to Slack/Microsoft Teams** \- Alert teams about conversation updates.

- **Rasayel to Asana/Trello** \- Create actionable tasks from chat updates.
